question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The detective's **__astute__** observations led to the discovery of crucial evidence, unlike his oblivious partner.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"astute"** means having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage. (चतुर)

 
 
• **Example: **His astute analysis of the market trends helped the company make profitable investments.
 
 
 
• **"Idiotic"** refers to something that is very foolish or stupid, showing a lack of good sense or judgment. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **It would be idiotic to ignore the safety warnings and proceed with the dangerous activity.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'astute' **is **'idiotic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Attentive** (सतर्क): Paying close attention to something.

 
 
• **Example: **The attentive student quickly understood the complex concepts explained by the teacher.
 
 
 
• **Keen** (उत्सुक): Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example: **She was keen to start her new job and make a positive impact.
 
 
 
• **Sharp** (तीक्ष्ण): Having or showing a quick-witted intelligence.
 
 
• **Example: **Her sharp mind allows her to solve problems that baffle others.
